paragraphs.text: Right-click menu for DeepSeek Harness chat links (reveal in Finder, copy path, open in browser) with
accurate workspace path resolution
# dsh-link-menu

A right-click menu for links in the DeepSeek Harness chat — **install it like
any other plugin, no p
atching, no setup script.**
Right-click a file reference in a message:
| Item | What it does |
| **Reveal in Finder** / 在 Finder 中显示 | Selects the file in Finder (`explorer /select` on Windows) |

| **Copy File Path** / 复制文件路径 | Copies the absolute path |
| **Copy Relative Path** / 复制相对路径 | Copi
es the path as the chat shows it |
Right-click an `http(s)` link:
| Item | What it does |

| **Open in Browser** / 在浏览器中打开 | Hands the URL to the system browser |
| **Copy Link Address** / 复制
链接地址 | Copies the URL |

re-signed app bundle.

## Nothing is patched

This started as a patch set and is now a plain plugin. It was rewritten after
finding that all four
things it needs already exist in a stock install:
| What the menu needs | Where it comes from | Patched? |

| the file path | `title` on the `<button>` the markdown renderer already produces | no |
| the work

space root | `ctx.sessions.list.getSnapshot().byId[id].cwd` | no |
| the session id | `data-conversa

tion-session` on the conversation root | no |
| the reveal | `remote.session.openWorkspacePath({ act
ion: "reveal" })` | no |

The native Electron context menu cannot help here — DSH renders a file mention
as `<button>`, not `<

a href>`, so Chromium reports `params.linkURL === ""` and
`main.js` never sees the target. So the pl

ugin draws its own popup and
`preventDefault()`s the native one. That is a normal client-plugin surf

ace, not
a workaround.
## Why an absolute path

`remote.session.openWorkspacePath` requires one. The Host maps it with
`fs.processPathFromHostPath`,

which returns `undefined` for anything relative
and fails with `"Path has no verified Host path"`.

The `title` on a mention is
often workspace-relative, so the plugin joins it onto the session's `cwd

`
first, keeping the OS separator style (POSIX `/`, Windows `\`).

If a path cannot be resolved — no session in the DOM, no `cwd` on the store —
the plugin leaves the

native menu alone and shows a short toast instead of
offering an action that would fail silently.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.1` (verified on `0.2.1-rc.5`, macOS arm64)
- Node `>= 20`
## Related

Several plugins cover adjacent ground and are worth a look if this one does not
fit: `dsh-filemenu`,

`dsh-file-context-menu`, `dsh-link-context-menu`,
`dsh-better-sidebar`. This package is deliberatel

y narrow: chat links only,
zero app patches.
